areas.power: The laptop will not turn on, or will not charge
areas.network: Problems connecting to Wi-Fi or the internet
areas.performance: The laptop is slow or overheating
areas.storage: The laptop will not start Windows/macOS, or has disk problems
areas.audio_input: Problems with sound, the keyboard or the touchpad

wont_turn_on.text: Does the laptop fail to turn on when you press the power button?

on_battery_only.text: Are you trying to use the laptop without the charger plugged in?

charger_plugged_in.text: Is the charger plugged into both the laptop and the wall socket?

charging_light_off.text: Is the charging light (on the laptop or the charger) off?

socket_works_for_other_devices.text: Does another device (like a phone charger) work in the same wall socket?

lights_or_fan_on.text: When you press the power button, do any lights or the fan come on?

external_monitor_shows_picture.text: If you connect an external monitor, does a picture appear on it?

not_charging.text: Is the battery not charging, even though the laptop is plugged in?

battery_drains_fast.text: Does the battery run out much faster than it used to?

battery_swollen.text: Is the laptop case bulging, or is the touchpad being pushed up?

laptop_over_3_years_old.text: Is the laptop more than 3 years old?

laptop_over_5_years_old.text: Is the laptop more than 5 years old?

screen_cracked.text: Is the screen cracked or smashed?

dead_pixels_or_lines.text: Are there dead pixels or coloured lines on the screen?

recently_dropped.text: Has the laptop been dropped or knocked recently?

screen_flickers.text: Does the screen flicker or tear?

flicker_worse_when_lid_moves.text: Does the flickering get worse when you move the lid?

screen_very_dim.text: Is the screen very dim, even at full brightness?

faint_image_with_torch.text: If you shine a torch at the screen, can you see a faint image?

no_wifi_networks_shown.text: Does the laptop show no Wi-Fi networks at all?

other_devices_work_on_wifi.text: Do other devices (like your phone) work fine on the same Wi-Fi?

airplane_mode_on.text: Is aeroplane mode turned on, or is the Wi-Fi switch or key turned off?

still_no_networks_after_restart.text: After restarting the laptop, does it still show no Wi-Fi networks?

connected_but_no_internet.text: Does it say it is connected to Wi-Fi, but websites will not load?

other_devices_also_offline.text: Do other devices on the same Wi-Fi also have no internet?

connection_keeps_dropping.text: Does the Wi-Fi connection keep dropping?

far_from_router.text: Are you far from the router, or in a different room or floor?

some_keys_not_working.text: Do some keys not work, or only work if you press them hard?

crumbs_or_dust_under_keys.text: Can you see crumbs or dust under or around the keys?

whole_keyboard_dead.text: Does the whole built-in keyboard not work at all?

usb_keyboard_works.text: If you plug in a USB keyboard, does it work?

touchpad_not_responding.text: Does the touchpad not respond at all?

usb_mouse_works.text: If you plug in a USB mouse, does it work?

touchpad_off_light_on.text: Is a touchpad light on, or is a 'touchpad off' icon showing?

touchpad_dead_after_restart.text: After restarting the laptop, is the touchpad still not working?

liquid_spilled.text: Has any liquid been spilled on the laptop?

laptop_runs_slowly.text: Is the laptop much slower than it used to be?

many_programs_at_startup.text: Do lots of programs open by themselves when the laptop starts?

laptop_hot_underneath.text: Does the laptop get very hot underneath?

fan_loud_all_the_time.text: Is the fan loud, even when you are only browsing?

dust_in_vents.text: Can you see dust in the air vents?

used_on_soft_surface.text: Do you often use the laptop on a bed, sofa or your lap?

storage_almost_full.text: Does your storage drive show as almost full (a red bar in File Explorer or Finder)?

wont_load_system.text: Does the laptop turn on but fail to load Windows or macOS?

no_boot_device_message.text: Does it show a message like 'No bootable device' or 'Operating system not found'?

clicking_noise.text: Does the laptop make clicking or grinding noises?

files_corrupted.text: Do files go missing, or fail to open with errors?

started_after_update.text: Did the problem start right after a system update?

faulty_charger.cause: The charger is probably faulty: the wall socket works, but no power reaches the laptop.

faulty_screen.cause: The laptop has power and an external monitor works, so the laptop's own screen or its cable is probably faulty.

worn_out_battery.cause: The battery has lost capacity with age.

swollen_battery.cause: The battery appears to be swollen, which is a fire risk.

damaged_screen_panel.cause: The screen panel is physically damaged, from a crack or a knock.

loose_display_cable.cause: The flicker changes when the lid moves and an external monitor works, so the display cable is probably loose.

failed_backlight.cause: A faint image is visible with a torch, so the screen works but its backlight has failed.

wifi_turned_off.cause: Aeroplane mode or the Wi-Fi switch is on, so the laptop is not looking for networks.

faulty_wifi_adapter.cause: Other devices see the Wi-Fi but this laptop sees no networks even after a restart, so its Wi-Fi adapter is probably faulty.

router_or_broadband_fault.cause: Every device on this Wi-Fi has no internet, so the problem is the router or the broadband, not the laptop.

laptop_network_settings_fault.cause: Other devices work on the same Wi-Fi, so this laptop's network settings are probably the problem.

weak_wifi_signal.cause: The connection drops and you are far from the router, so the signal is too weak where you are.

dirty_keyboard.cause: Crumbs or dust under the keys are stopping them from pressing properly.

keyboard_ribbon_cable_fault.cause: A USB keyboard works but the built-in one does not, so the keyboard or its ribbon cable inside the laptop is probably loose or broken.

touchpad_turned_off.cause: A USB mouse works and the touchpad off light or icon is showing, so the touchpad has been switched off.

touchpad_hardware_fault.cause: A USB mouse works but the touchpad stays dead after a restart, so the touchpad or its cable is probably faulty.

water_damage.cause: Liquid has been spilled and parts of the laptop have stopped working, so liquid has probably got inside.

recommendations.recommend_charge_battery: Plug in the charger, wait 15 minutes, then try turning the laptop on again.
recommendations.recommend_replace_charger: Try a different compatible charger. If that works, replace the original charger.
recommendations.recommend_screen_repair: Have the screen or display cable repaired by a technician.
recommendations.recommend_consider_new_laptop: The laptop is over 5 years old, so a screen repair may cost more than the laptop is worth. Consider replacing it.
recommendations.recommend_replace_battery: Check the battery health in your system settings and replace the battery if its capacity is low.
recommendations.recommend_stop_using_immediately: Stop using and charging the laptop now, and take it to a repair shop. Do not press on or puncture the battery.
recommendations.recommend_replace_screen_panel: Have the screen panel replaced by a technician. Avoid touching any broken glass.
recommendations.recommend_reseat_display_cable: Have a technician reseat or replace the display cable inside the lid.
recommendations.recommend_backlight_repair: Have the backlight or screen panel repaired. Use an external monitor in the meantime.
recommendations.recommend_turn_on_wifi: Turn off aeroplane mode, or press the Wi-Fi key or switch, then look for networks again.
recommendations.recommend_wifi_adapter_repair: Update the Wi-Fi driver. If that does not help, use a USB Wi-Fi adapter or have the Wi-Fi card repaired.
recommendations.recommend_restart_router: Turn the router off for 30 seconds and back on. If the internet is still down, contact your broadband provider.
recommendations.recommend_reset_network_settings: Forget the Wi-Fi network, reconnect with the password, and run the network troubleshooter in your system settings.
recommendations.recommend_move_closer_to_router: Move closer to the router, or use a Wi-Fi extender or a network cable.
recommendations.recommend_clean_keyboard: Turn the laptop off, tip it upside down and gently shake it, then use compressed air between the keys.
recommendations.recommend_keyboard_repair: Use a USB keyboard for now, and have a technician reseat or replace the keyboard ribbon cable.
recommendations.recommend_turn_on_touchpad: Press the touchpad key (often one of the F keys), or turn the touchpad on in your system settings.
recommendations.recommend_touchpad_repair: Use a USB mouse for now, and have a technician check the touchpad and its cable.
recommendations.recommend_power_off_and_dry: Turn the laptop off and unplug it straight away. Do not turn it on again until a technician has checked it.
